items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 40:1
items.html: The 37 sparks are the measure of the coarseness in the filling of HaVaYaH of SAG, meaning what is fit to bring out upon them the level of Bina and Neshama. (Item 2).
